proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1437 āviśati explicitly includes Bengali āisā to come. The eastern aśa/aʃa/asa and Hajong/Bishnupriya aha-/aha-ni responses are linked to that regional coming family, with contraction of the vowel sequence and s/h realization recorded as qualifications. This is a family link with inter-Indo-Aryan transmission unresolved, not a claim that the Sanskrit form directly predicts every inflection. Exact response: aśa.
